description: One element of the instructions of the -ac, -sc and -dc switches (JB_context_change).
An element whose name is +, - or = starts a group that adds, deletes or sets the
context variables following it; names repeat by design, so the name is not unique.

attributes.name: variable
description: Name of the context variable, or one of the markers +, - and =.

attributes.name: value
description: Value of the context variable as string.
